apps.localizedDescription:
nettai is rollback netplay for Mega Man Battle Network 4, 5 and 6. Make a build, then play a friend online, practice, or watch your old matches.

You'll need Mega Man Battle Network Legacy Collection Vol. 2 on Steam. nettai uses the graphics and sound from it: a computer running nettai on the same network sends it to your phone.
